notes.title: Thai localization update!
notes.notes:
Thai localization now available!
We are expanding our list of supported languages by another one, Thai!



Massive thank you to all contributors!



Other changes:

Improved localization for all non-latin script languages (Chinese, Thai). Fixed an issue with line breaks in unnatural spaces.

Updated the project to Godot 4.4



Big thank you as well to everyone leaving feedback whether here in the Steam community or over at Itch.io! We are observing user sentiment with great interest...
